section.title: Development resources
section.para: The development process is currently coordinated using Agama’s repository at Github.

This section contains a lot of technical information about Agama development. The Agama’s architecture offers a nice overview about the project and it might be a good starting point. If you want to set up your development environment, we may suggest to read running from sources.
Feel free to review the rest of the sections in no particular order.
